abstract: Recurrence of teratoma or carcinoma in testis cancer patients found to have teratoma at post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy is well recognized. We report a case of an intra-abdominal desmoid tumor discovered 2 years following post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy in a testis cancer patient who had teratoma at the time of lymphadenectomy. To our knowledge this is the first case of an intra-abdominal desmoid tumor discovered in this setting. The characteristics and treatment considerations of this unusual tumor are described. Desmoid tumor should be included in the differential diagnosis of tumor recurrence in testis cancer patients previously subjected to post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy.
abstract_ja: 化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受け、郭清標本で奇形腫が認められた精巣がん患者において、その2年後に発見された腹腔内デスモイド腫瘍の稀な症例を報告する。我々の知る限り、この状況で腹腔内デスモイド腫瘍が発見されたのは初めての症例である。この稀な腫瘍の特徴と治療上の考慮点を述べる。化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた精巣がん患者の腫瘍再発の鑑別診断には、デスモイド腫瘍を含めるべきである。
